title: Synthetic sample 1: video tracking of C57BL/6N mice in the open-field test
abstract: SYNTHETIC SAMPLE TEXT written for software tests; it does not describe a real study. Adult C57BL/6N mice, individually housed, were recorded in the open-field test with a side-view camera through the clear cage wall. We quantified locomotor activity and rearing from video. Bedding and enrichment objects produced frequent occlusion. A fibre photometry tether was attached in a subset of sessions.

title: Synthetic sample 2: video tracking of BALB/c mice in the home-cage monitoring
abstract: SYNTHETIC SAMPLE TEXT written for software tests; it does not describe a real study.
